fact: INCM's 2024 annual regulation report states that each licensed telecom operator pays 1% of its prior-year gross revenue into the Fundo de Serviço de Acesso Universal (FSAU) under the law in force (instrument not named), and that the fund financed Praças Digitais, school computer rooms, Internet nas Escolas, a rural digital-TV pilot and rural mobile network expansion in 2024; the report carries no date, so its reference year is used.
system: Fundo de Serviço de Acesso Universal (FSAU)

fact: Decree 11/2025 of 16 May 2025 (Council of Ministers, approved 22 April 2025) approves a new regulation of the Universal Access Service Fund (FSAU), repealing Decree 62/2017, and fixes the levy at 1% of each licensed telecom operator's prior-year gross revenue, with the money applied to rural infrastructure (up to 55%), digital inclusion, broadcasting, running costs and innovation; it also assigns 60% of fines under the regulation to the fund and names state budget allocations as a revenue source, but states no amount collected or paid out.
system: Fundo do Serviço de Acesso Universal (FSAU)
